parties: CMR Green Technologies Limited (issuer); Equirus Capital Limited, ICICI Securities Limited, Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Limited (BRLMs); Global Scrap Processors Limited (selling shareholder); Promoter and Promoter Group (selling shareholders)
headline: CMR Green Technologies ₹630.6 crore offer-for-sale IPO advised by Crawford Bayley, DSK Legal, Hogan Lovells and Quillon Partners
sum: CMR Green Technologies, India's largest non-ferrous metal recycler, launched a ₹630.6 crore offer-for-sale IPO comprising 32.86 million equity shares, with Equirus Capital, ICICI Securities and Motilal Oswal as book running lead managers; Crawford Bayley advised the issuer, DSK Legal the BRLMs, Hogan Lovells the international counsel to BRLMs, and Quillon Partners the selling shareholder Global Scrap Processors Limited.
implication: OFS structures in green recycling / secondary materials demand careful coordination between promoter, investor and public liquidity tranche counsel; the international counsel slot (Hogan Lovells) signals cross-border investor participation or tax/regulatory complexity in a metals recycling story.
detail: The IPO is an offer for sale (no fresh capital raise) by promoter, promoter-group and investor selling shareholders. CMR Green Technologies is positioned as India's largest non-ferrous metal recycler and a major secondary aluminium products supplier. The transaction required due diligence, SEBI prospectus review (DRHP, RHP, final), stock exchange and ROC filings, SEBI query responses, intermediary consents and comprehensive transaction agreements. Hogan Lovells' involvement as international counsel to the BRLMs suggests potential cross-border regulatory or investor base considerations.
